programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A brilliant if arrogant teen detective comes to town, determined to capture Kid the Phantom Thief. This turns the heat up for Kaito, especially since they're classmates. In fact, Kaito becomes Suguru's rival even out of uniform, leading to a "gentlemen's bet" over which of them will go on a date with Aoko.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito has a new classmate, Akako, who appears to possess genuine magic abilities, the kind that bend everyone to her will... except for Kaito and his alter ego, Kid the Phantom Thief! Who will come out on top in the inevitable showdown, sorceress or illusionist?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: When Oga wakes up one morning, he's floating in a great pool of water... However it is actually Baby Beel's pee, as it is "urination season" right now in the Demon World. Oga is concerned about the entire city being inundated and humanity's imminent destruction, so he takes Baby Beel to the drug store to buy some disposable diapers. While he's there, a bunch of bank robbers a take Oga, Baby Beel, Hilda and Furuichi (who were chasing after him) as hostages.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: On the back of Oga's fist a mark appears that is proof of his contract with the son of the Demon Lord, Beelzebub... The Zebul Spell. After hearing that the demonic power grows as well as the Zebul Spell the more he gets into fights and runs wild, Oga decides not to fight anymore to avoid that situation. However, Himekawa Tatsuya, heir to the Himekawa Zaibatsu and one of Ishiyama's TKKH like Kanzaki, is secretly plotting to do Oga in himself, and gives the command to his lackeys...

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: "A - Hilda brought back a bunch of toys from the Demon World for Baby Beel. When Oga and Hilda were assemble one, a horrible accident occurs! B - The Zebul Spell expands when one does evil. So won't it contract if you act like an angel? ...thinks Oga, who uses a Play Doctor toy with Beel as the doctor to try and heal patients. It's time to play Demon World Doctor!"

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lupin is in Hong Kong for a vacation when he is asked to find a woman in return for helping him escape from Inspector Zenigata. Lupin discovers the pickpocket who stole his wallet is the daughter of the woman he is looking for, and in her possession are the archeologically significant bones of the Peking Man. With Fujiko also after the Peking Man, will Lupin be able to add the bones to his private collection?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Sleeping Lion, a statue made of solid gold, is being transported to a museum by a specially armored, airtight car to mark the 50th anniversary of Australia's independence. Lupin steals the armored car together with the statue out from under the Sydney Police's watchful eye, but then discovers that also inside the armored car is a nearly asphyxiated Inspector Zenigata. Will Lupin choose the golden statue over Inspector Zenigata's life?

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: With his father's help, Al takes incredible steps to contain the monstrous Pride. As the sun begins to rise on the Promised Day, the youngest Elric listens while the Homunculus ponders his very human mother.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Mustang leads a ragtag assault force of hardy northern troops - and welcome faces from the past - against Central's defenses. Victory seems certain until the military's most horrifying secret is revealed.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Ed's crew faces a horde of ravenous mannequins, abominations powered by human souls. The twisted creatures aren't the only unstoppable force on the battlefield - Pride, Sloth, and Envy are on the move.

programme.title: Naruto the Movie: Legend of the Stone of Gelel [English Dub]
programme.desc: Drawn into a fierce struggle over the legendary Stone of Gelel, Naruto, Shikamaru, and Sakura must keep the stone from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Blue Typhoon attempts to save a small ship caught in the crossfire between them and the Metarex. Unfortunately, the pilot aboard the spaceship was Decoe, who was acting as a decoy to lure Sonic into the path of Megarex fleet led by Dr. Eggman.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Chaotix still aren't able to find their home. programme.title: Sonic X

programme.desc: Hilda hears about Kunieda Aoi from Oga and wants to find out more. She goes in search of her to test her skills. At the same time, there's someone with a half-baked scheme against Oga using Aoi's protective attitude.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lupin has been put on auction at the Wanted Club and Dr. Mad places the winning bid. Dr. Mad also purchases Fujiko and Jigen from the Wanted Club's auctions. programme.desc: Lloyd, having been kicked out of the Hynobrai snake tribe unlocks a second tribe – The Fangpyres – to help him regain control. The Ninja are busy setting up their new HQ that Zane discovered, but are called to duty when the Fangpyres attack the village where Jay's family lives.

programme.title: Seed and Soil and Just Under the Surface Compilation
programme.desc: A journey through hidden landscapes and mysterious underground worlds reveals powerful discoveries, ancient secrets, and exciting challenges as heroes uncover what lies beneath the surface.

programme.title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Avengers Reassembled
programme.desc: The Avengers must now fight one of their own, and they're not sure what to do! Cap and Thor lead the charge, but can't fend off Iron Man and Ultron's Minions. Meanwhile, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Hulk track down a signal that seems to be controlling Iron Man from a castle in the “Little Sokovia” section of New York. There they fight HYDRA and BARON VON STRUCKER and learn that YELLOWJACKET is the “bug” that infected Iron Man's suit for Ultron. To help break Iron Man free from Ultron's control, the Avengers call in their own bug...ANT MAN! Finally, the Avengers confront Ultron and his Ultron Minions as they attack Avengers' Tower. Ultron's ultimate plan: use all the data/stuff they've stolen to free the newly rebuilt IRON LEGION, destroy the Avengers, and control the world. Tony dons the hastily repaired Hulk Buster Armor and it's on! It's a huge battle as the Avengers try to save their beloved HQ and defeat Ultron. Will they succeed? And, more importantly, can their party be saved after Ultron tries to take down their Tower?The Avengers prepare for a party with a surprise guest when Ultron crashes the preparations by using mind control on Iron Man. While trying to rescue their leader, the rest of the team discovers that Baron Stucker, HYDRA, and Yellowjacket are in on Ultron's plans. While preparing for a party at Avengers' Tower, THE AVENGERS (IRON MAN, CAPTAIN AMERICA, BLACK WIDOW, HAWKEYE, THOR, HULK and VISION) notice Iron Man acting strangely. When Iron Man volunteers to go out and get more ice, they find it odd: when has Tony every volunteered to get anything? Suddenly, ULTRON appears on a screen: he's taken control of Iron Man! To make matters worse, Ultron takes over all the versions of Iron Man's armor and they fly off!

programme.title: King of the Shadows
programme.desc: The ninja successfully recover three of the four Golden Weapons, leaving only the Sword of Fire, but dangerous confrontations have to be made to keep the weapons out of Garmadon's reach.

programme.title: The Power Of Merlok
programme.desc: When Jestro attacks a village on the far side of the Kingdom, the NEXO-Knights wonder how they'll get there. Then Macy remembers her dad has a royal RV…maybe they can “mod” that for their own, “knightly” use? Now the NEXO-Knights get rolling…in THE FORTREX, their own ROLLING CASTLE! This great new HQ, which houses Merlok 2.0 as an operating system, will be how the knights move around Knighton and protect it from Jestro and his monsters. Speaking of the evil jester, in this episode Jestro uses some newly-made monsters to attack a town far from the capitol where he thinks he's safe from the Knights' reach. We see two parallel stories here: the Knights training, learning more about digital magic and getting organized as a team and at the same time we see Jestro making monsters, trying to learn how his powers work and talking to the Book. In the end, the Knights roll up in their castle and defeat Jestro and his marauding monsters. Lance thinks he should be the leader because he's a snot. “Of course I'm the leader…I'm a Richmond.”

programme.title: The Warrior Within
programme.desc: Cragger tricks Laval into withholding CHI from the Crocodile tribe. This reignites the hostilities between the Lions and Crocodiles. Laval must frantically escape the wrath of the Crocs and somehow get rid of the CHI before his father finds out.

programme.title: Rip and Tear
programme.desc: Destruction strikes, but heroes rebuild stronger than before. Can they save the day and make things better?

programme.title: Give 'Em a Hand and Natural Habitat Compilation

programme.title: The Hybrid Horror!
programme.desc: A terrified hybrid dinosaur rampages through the park, causing chaos and creating cover for Danny and Sinjin as they try to steal the Nedry videotape.

programme.title: The Snowball Effect
programme.desc: Laval and Li'Ella's relationship grows as he gives her a tour of the Lion City. But distracted, he misses a key battle against the Hunters. Tormak joins the fight and saves the day. But the Lion King Lagravis is captured and brought to the Ice Fort. Who will lead the Lions now?!?

programme.title: The Spectral Lands
programme.desc: Arin ventures into a dangerous new land to heal Ras while Nya and Kai come up with a plan to make Jay come to them.

programme.title: The Great Zane Robbery

programme.title: Seed and Soil
programme.desc: Lloyd enters the Temple of the Green Ninja and faces a shocking, deadly trial. Meanwhile, Sora, Frak, and Wyldfyre are attacked in Umbrasylvis with a friend's life at risk, as the Loyalists near their goal and reveal their leader.

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.
